reason: About $317 to move ten lakh is way too much when my Indian bank charges a few hundred rupees for the same remittance. I'd pay for convenience, but not 2%, and it isn't even live until 2027.
objection: 2% plus a flat fee is a lot when my bank charges a few hundred rupees. FINTRAC registration is still only 'in process' and I'd be handing over lakhs to a company that hasn't launched.
would_change_my_mind: A fee under about 0.5% (roughly CAD $80 on 10 lakh), plus the FINTRAC registration done and some track record.
